_doc: The body lab's scenarios (README.md). The lab expands these axes into scenarios: every weapon at every range into every spot (revolver_05m_thigh ... shotgun_30m_hand), and dynamite at every distance (dynamite_1m ...); `check` (each man's wounds, severing, stumps and hat) and `perf` (ten wounded men) are their own. A spot is a point inside the man in the anatomy's rest pose (config/anatomy.json: metres, +x his right, -z the way he faces), on the segment named; the shooter stands `range` metres in front of him with his eye at `eye_height`, sighted on the spot's world position with the gun's sights regulated as in the game (WeaponViewmodel.zeroed, the muzzle at the eye). `aims_for` is what a ball through that spot should cross. Treatments are applied to a copy of his physiology after the live seconds, at `at` seconds after the hit. Edit this file to add spots, ranges or treatments; no code change needed.

thigh.note: the front of his right thigh over the femoral artery

neck.note: the right side of his neck over the carotid

upper_arm.note: mid right upper arm: the brachial artery and the humerus

chest.note: left of the breastbone, over the heart

hand.note: the right hand's metacarpals, hanging at his side

dynamite.note: one stick (BlastTuning.tnt_per_stick) lying on the ground that far in front of him

treatments.name: tourniquet
treatments.note: a belt above every limb bleed too fast to clot (as OutlawBrain._tend and PlayerWounds._tend do); not applicable off the limbs

treatments.name: packing
treatments.note: pressure and a binding on every outside bleed (as the brain's and the player's 'packed and bound')

treatments.name: doctor
treatments.note: packed at 30 s, then the doctor at 10 min: every bleed tied off, lungs sealed, gut sewn (PlayerWounds._patch_up's surgery, no blood given back)
